_why: The two files under `frontend/` beside this manifest are VERBATIM copies of
CodeTracer's `src/frontend/viewmodel/viewmodels/flow_layout.nim` and the
`src/frontend/ui/flow_loop_math.nim` it imports. Together they are the
Omniscience layout arithmetic — expression columns, legend columns,
indentation, the loop-iteration window and the before/after value modes —
with no pixel, no unit, no CSS class and no DOM node in the answer. That
extraction happened upstream on 2026-08-29 specifically so a renderer that
is not Monaco could draw omniscience; this is that renderer's copy.
WHY A COPY AND NOT AN IMPORT. Both modules ARE exported through
`codetracer_embed.nim`, so unlike `layout_model.nim` there is a facade
route to them and reaching for one would not be an internal-module import.
The reason is the other one `layout_model.vendor.json` gives, and it is the
harder constraint: the client's build is hermetic. `flake.nix` pins isonim,
nim-everywhere and the design system and nothing else, so `nix build
.#default` has no CodeTracer checkout on the Nim path at all, and
`static_export.nim` MUST render the inline values — Page-Descriptions §7.0
requires the served page to be the session's first frame, not a frame with
the values missing until a bundle loads. AGENTS.md §1a states the layering
as a fact about bytes: `client/hydrate/` is the only compilation in this
repository that links a debugger. Importing the Embed SDK here to place a
label would end that.
WHY THE DIRECTORY LOOKS LIKE CODETRACER'S. `flow_layout.nim` imports
`../../ui/flow_loop_math`. Mirroring the two directory levels that import
crosses is what lets BOTH files stay byte-identical to upstream — the
alternative is a one-line edit to the import path, and a vendored copy with
one edit in it is a copy whose hash can no longer be compared to anything.
WHAT KEEPS THE COPY HONEST is `ci/test/flow-layout-vendor.sh`:
A. the bytes here still hash to the sha256s below (no local edits), and
B. against a real CodeTracer checkout, a probe imports BOTH copies and
compares what a consumer observes — `computeFlowLayout` over a fixed
window, `assignExpressionColumns`, `orderExpressionsByColumn`,
`resolveFlowValueModeForText`, `sourceIndentLevel`,
`computeLoopColumnPlan` and `activeIterationForTicks` — so a change
upstream fails here rather than leaving BlockTracer placing labels to
an arithmetic nobody else uses.
NOTE ON THE COMMIT. This one IS `ci/embed-sdk-pin.env`'s `CODETRACER_REF`,
and that is the difference from `layout_model.vendor.json`: these two files
are inside `src/frontend/viewmodel/`, which is the tree the Embed SDK pin
names, so `client/hydrate/` compiles against the very same source. The
static export and the hydration bundle therefore place labels with one
arithmetic and not two, which is the property the whole route rests on and
the reason to keep this commit equal to the pin when either moves.
